subject: Banking
title: Bankruptcy: The Nuclear Option
description: A fast breakdown of Bankruptcy: The Nuclear Option for builders.

hook.text: 770,000 Americans filed for bankruptcy in 2022. It wipes out most debts but stays on your credit report for 10 years.

buildup.text: Chapter 7 liquidates assets to pay debts and then discharges the rest. Chapter 13 creates a 3-5 year repayment plan.

discovery.text: After bankruptcy, your score drops to 450-550. But for people already drowning, it provides a genuine fresh start.

twist.text: Credit card companies actively market to people who just filed bankruptcy.

climax.text: Bankruptcy is devastating but sometimes necessary. The stigma is worse than the reality for people trapped in debt.

punchline.text: 10 years on your report. But credit card offers arrive immediately after filing.

quiz.question: Why do credit card companies market to recent bankruptcy filers?
options: Filers can't file again for 8 years, making them low second-default risk

details.summary: Bankruptcy is a legal process that eliminates or restructures debt for individuals or businesses that cannot repay their obligations. It provides a fresh start but devastates credit scores for 7 to 10 years and carries lasting financial consequences.
details.whyItMatters: Bankruptcy exists because a functioning economy needs a way for people and businesses overwhelmed by debt to start over. Without it, permanent debt traps would destroy economic mobility and discourage the risk-taking that drives innovation.
takeaways: Chapter 7 bankruptcy eliminates most debts but may require asset liquidation
Chapter 13 reorganizes debt into a 3 to 5 year repayment plan
Bankruptcy stays on credit reports for 7 to 10 years

faq.question: Does bankruptcy erase all debt?
faq.answer: No. Student loans, tax debts, child support, and alimony generally survive bankruptcy. Chapter 7 eliminates credit card and medical debt. Chapter 13 restructures payments but requires you to repay a portion of what you owe.

faq.question: How quickly can you rebuild credit after bankruptcy?
faq.answer: With discipline, you can get a secured credit card immediately and see meaningful credit score improvement within 2 to 3 years. The bankruptcy stays on your report for 7 to 10 years, but its impact diminishes as time passes.
